nom: I Dew Care Glow To Bed Brightening Korean Yuzu Sleeping Mask

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe the mask as hydrating and thick-textured, saying it suits dry skin well and leaves skin softer and less dry by morning.
segments.sensitive: Two reviewers with sensitive skin found the thick, gentle formula comfortable and reported no irritation.
segments.mature: One reviewer felt her skin looked younger and fresher after use, comparing results to when she was a teen.

concerns.aging: One reviewer reports her under-eye area and overall complexion looked younger and fresher; another says her face felt younger the day after use.
concerns.dehydration: Numerous reviewers report visibly plumper, softer, hydrated skin the morning after use, including on dry skin; one notes it addressed dryness directly.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers mention dark spots fading or looking less noticeable with continued use, including one who saw gradual fading over weeks; results are described as gradual rather than dramatic.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer notes the mask does not clog pores; no reviewer reports breakouts or clogged pores from use.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with otherwise normal skin found the balm-like texture slightly greasy in heat, and another found the texture too greasy for her taste, though both still saw brightening effects.

extraits.titre: Nice glow but too sticky for me
extraits.texte: I really wanted to love this mask because the packaging is cute and the yuzu scent is fresh and pleasant. It does give a nice glow the next morning, but I couldn't get past the sticky texture. Even after it absorbed a bit, it still felt tacky on my skin, which made it uncomfortable to sleep with. It's not a bad product overall, but the stickiness just isn't for me. I got this product for free. Complimentary from idewcare

Gifted by brand. This Brightening overnight mask works wonderful love that it is so hydrating and the container is so fun and it glows in the dark. I love that this is so thick a it is gentle on my sensitive skin. This has left my skin feeling great.

I received this as complimentary from Dew Care. Ive always been fan of Korea skin care and this product also gives more hydrating and gives my face subtle glow from inside. Very good and suitable for dry skin

I love yuzu masks soo much! They clear away my dark under eyes and my skin has never looked so young and fresh since I was a teen! Not the biggest fan of the consistency of this one, but besides that still does the job and I love it! Gifted

Always game for a good night mask and I really liked this one! I was gifted this Glow to Bed Brightening Korean Overnight Mask complimentary from I Dew Care. It has a very light, almost faint scent that's both pleasant and barely there. While the texture was a bit greasy for me, it does eventually absorb into your skin, but it takes a bit of massaging in. It goes on for the entire night and after rinsing with warm water in the morning, my complexion was definitely clearer and brighter. It's no miracle worker, but does provide fairly immediate results that leave your skin refreshed! Definitely look forward to continued use!

Gifted by I Dew Care I usually sleep late and deal with tired skin and a few dark spots. This sleeping mask fits perfectly into my routine, lightweight, non-greasy, and no pillow transfer. I wake up with softer, more even skin and a healthy glow. It's simple but effective, and my dark spots are slowly fading.

extraits.titre: skin feels hydrated on the next day
extraits.texte: Glad that i got a chance to try this product. Another brand of sleeping mask with relatively thicker texture, therefore it's good for dry skin. Easily put it as the last step before going to bed, my skin feels well hydrated on the next day (gifted by idewcare)
